text:
ana: Fresh tenant, followed the javascript quickstart. First call returned 402 with message `dpa_required`. Console billing shows credits and card. Wtf?

peter: dpa_required? That's new. Can you paste the exact response body (redact keys)?

ana: Response: `{
  "error": {"code": "payment_required", "message": "workspace requires legal consent: dpa", "subcode": "dpa_required"}
}`

legal-bot: Automated scan: workspace=WREG-EU-01, billing_status=active, payment_method=on_file, legal_flags=[dpa_missing], admin=ana@acme.co.uk

ops: We recently rolled out a regional DPA checkbox for EU workspaces to ensure customers explicitly accept our data processing terms before enabling hosted inference in-region. It's separate from billing.

ana: Ah that explains it. The Console billing page didn't show that checkbox prominently. I only saw the card and promo.

sdk-team: Two quick suggestions: 1) SDKs should map `payment_required:dpa_required` to a clear error and include `help_url` to Console > Legal 2) Quickstart READMEs should mention region-specific legal opt-ins for first-call gating.

peter: Workaround: admin can go to Console -> Settings -> Legal -> Accept Data Processing Addendum. Or provision a user-scoped key (interactive user who accepted the DPA) instead of service token.

ana: I can accept it as admin now. Doing that...

legal-bot: Update: dpa_accepted=true for WREG-EU-01 by ana@acme.co.uk at 2026-03-23T10:12:05Z

ana: Retried the quickstart generate call and got 200. First successful call! :tada:

ops: Filing ENG ticket to add DPA acceptance banner on billing flow for EU tenants and to include `dpa_required` as a distinct error code.

sdk-team: We'll add explicit handling in the next SDK patch: subcode parsing + console link. Also adding a short line in the JS quickstart about regional legal gates.

ana: Saved a confusing 40 minutes. Leaving a small note in the repo PR about the Console UX so others don't hit this.
